description.value:
Run the ashways where maps burn out.

Level 3: Ashway Sprint (BBTTCC)

When you lead travel through Wasteland or Desert hexes, you may reduce the Logistics OP cost of that hex crossing by 1 (minimum 1) once per travel action. In addition, you and up to PB allies gain +10 ft movement speed for 1 hour after the travel begins, ending early if you or they stop traveling for more than 1 minute.

Level 3: Ghost Stamp

As a bonus action, place a Ghost Stamp at your feet. Until the start of your next turn, allies that start their turn within 5 ft of the stamp may use a bonus action to Dash. Uses per long rest = your proficiency bonus.

Level 6: Dust Veil

If you move at least 20 ft on your turn, ranged attacks against you have disadvantage until the start of your next turn.

Level 10: Wake of Routes

Spaces you moved through this turn count as not difficult terrain for your allies until the start of your next turn.

Level 14: Dead Drop

Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you can deliver a Tiny or smaller item to a Ghost Stamp, Courier Cache, or marked drop-site within 600 ft, so long as a continuous traversable route (no solid barriers) exists between you and it. The item appears harmlessly at that cache.

Level 18: Ashen Run Apex

Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you enter an apex courier trance for 1 minute: your speed increases by 20 ft; you ignore difficult terrain; you have advantage on Dexterity saves; you can move through creature spaces without provoking opportunity attacks; and the first time each round you move at least 20 ft, one creature you passed within 5 ft must save (Dex, DC = 8 + PB + Dex mod) or be knocked prone. Completing a major courier/rescue/delivery under this effect may grant +1 Intrigue OP and +1 Unity as legends spread of your run.
